jp.title: 九州から東北は雨 北海道は雪や吹雪 全国的に風が冷たい 今日9日(月)の天気

world.title: Protein Leverage Hypothesis: Why Low-Protein Diets May Increase Calorie Intake
world.description: The protein leverage hypothesis proposes that diets with a lower proportion of protein may encourage people to consume more calories as they seek to maintain protein intake. Research examines how appetite signals, protein quality, and food environments influence this response and its possible role in weight management.

world.title: An ancient ocean full of giant predators reveals a surprising twist in evolution
world.description: A remarkable fossil discovery in Colombia is challenging how scientists understand major evolutionary changes in Earth's history. Researchers uncovered an incredibly diverse ancient marine ecosystem where giant reptiles, sharks, and other creatures thrived as older evolutionary groups approached extinction and newer ones emerged. They call this previously unrecognized pattern a "Biotic Inflection," suggesting that major transformations in life can occur without mass extinctions.
